aiContext:
K-Plex portable Facets authoring, format kplex-preset version 1.
Generate a JSON object with format, version, kind="facets", id, preset, aiContext. Optional palette and explicitly requested lenses are data dependencies. No enabled state, canvas/session state, navigation, ontology, index policy, scripts, secrets, personal note contents or remote permissions.
Use the canonical validator in src/core/plex/sharing/validation.ts. Documentation:
https://github.com/zsviczian/kplex/blob/main/docs/FACETS.md
https://github.com/zsviczian/kplex/blob/main/docs/CANVAS_VIEW_API.md
https://github.com/zsviczian/kplex/blob/main/docs/FACETS_AUTHORING.md
https://github.com/zsviczian/kplex/blob/main/docs/PORTABLE_PRESETS.md
The GUI and future CLI use the same validator. Do not invent fields or claim CLI commands exist.

Preset required fields: version=1; name (1-100 chars); source=property|type|tag|rules; field (1-128 chars); categories keyed by stable IDs; order of 3-7 unique category IDs; start naming an ordered category; spacing24-200; regionWidth200-640; regionHeight160-600; guides/tints booleans; conflictingColor/unassignedColor; helpMarkdown. IDs use letters/digits/dot/underscore/hyphen, start alphanumeric, max48; never prototype names. Labels max80. Category: label,color,values (string aliases), optional assignment (explicit canonical write value), optional rule (max2048). No translation keys. Property matching is case-sensitive after trimming; multiple category matches conflict. Assignment is separately authorized by explicit safe values and the native preview; rules/type/tag categories are read-only for assignment. Missing metadata is unknown, not false or empty.

Rules reuse K-Plex's predicate parser. Examples: note.phase == "wood"; note.state == "draft" && note.priority >= 3; this.phase == "wood" && note.phase == "metal"; edge.role == "parent". Namespaces: note(candidate Markdown properties), this(current focus, built-ins reserved), node,file,edge,evidence. Strict == preserves type/case; .equals() ignores text case; .contains() tests collection/text; &&, ||, ! and parentheses combine predicates. No eval, JavaScript, arithmetic, AI/prose scores, queries or external fetch. Edge role: parent,child,left,right,previous,next,sibling; kind: defined,inferred; direction: from,to,both. Actual canonical evidence is mandatory for recorded edges. No fabricated focus self-edge. Unavailable data stays unknown under negation. Avoid path/name/private selectors in public packages; exports require explicit privacy acknowledgement if detected.

Optional presentation: layout=circular|concentric|vertical|horizontal|quadrants; quadrants requires4 categories (otherwise explicit circular fallback). focusAnchor=top|bottom|left|right applies to linear layouts. reverse boolean changes geometry, not logical category sequence. Circular/concentric keep one centered focus/editor. Width-driven automatic measured columns are intrinsic, not a configurable columns field. areaSizes may contain categories keyed by category ID and diagnostics keyed combined|unassigned|conflicting|checking|unresolved, each optional width200-2400/height160-1200. Concentric widths/heights mean band thickness with genuine inner holes; cards use the top strip. Canvas handle overrides do not travel in packages.

diagnostics optional: combined(default true),side=top|right|bottom|left,orientation=horizontal|vertical,showEmpty boolean,order containing all4 diagnostic statuses exactly once. Combined Diagnostics keeps per-note chips/reasons and never means clearing a property on drop. Unknown/conflicting/unassigned meanings stay distinct. Per-canvas choices never overwrite preset defaults.

flow optional: direction=forward|backward|both,style=arrow|line|none,caption(max80),captionPosition=start|middle|end. flowOverrides(max21) add stable source/target category IDs for unordered unique pairs. Linear guides use the logical sequence despite reverse geometry; rails run outside regions, away from the focused editor. Blank caption suppresses inherited caption. These are decorative: no semantic endpoints, graph evidence or editing authority. Concentric/quadrants have no workflow rails. Optional interpretation="wuxing",relativeLabels/regulatingGuides preserve Wood->Fire->Earth->Metal->Water and the independent generating/regulating model; phase-derived roles never rewrite stored phase or canonical relationships.

Every generated preset MUST include useful, preset-specific helpMarkdown (max4096 characters) explaining purpose, exact categories/rules, actual YAML examples for the chosen properties/values, how to use it, and limits/unknown metadata. Do not invent features or write generic promotional copy. Help is end-user documentation, separate from this inert aiContext. Optional helpSourceLocale identifies literal language. Markdown supports headings/lists/code and HTTPS links; no raw HTML, embeds, images, executable code, unsafe links or remote content. Code fences display as plain examples. Keep authored source intact.

Colors: hex/RGB(A)/transparent literal, {kind:"theme",variable:"--color-blue"}, or {kind:"palette",id:"stable-id"}. Optional palette(max32) contains referenced pairs only: id,name,light,dark literals. No arbitrary CSS. Do not sample a device theme into permanent colors. Lens dependencies are opt-in only and imported disabled. Package max65536 characters/8192 JSON nodes/depth12; stored view configuration retains its separate16384-character/depth8/4096-node limit and max16 presets. Keep Help and rules concise enough for the installed library. No unknown/prototype/executable fields. Preview exact collisions/dependencies; Cancel or failed writes must preserve old state. Import never edits notes or activates a lens/view. Return JSON only when requested, with this documentation in aiContext as inert text.

preset.name: ARC
preset.helpMarkdown:
# ARC: Add, Relate, Communicate

Use ARC to notice how a nearby idea moves from collection toward connection and expression. This is a local K-Plex adaptation of Nick Milo’s ARC, not his complete system or an automatic measure of progress.

## Categories and data

- **Add**: material you deliberately classify as an input or starting point.
- **Relate**: ideas you are connecting and developing.
- **Communicate**: knowledge you want to explain or share.

The default source is the Markdown property `arc`. Matching is exact and case-sensitive. For example:

```yaml
arc: relate
```

Allowed default values are `add`, `relate` and `communicate`. The focused note stays in the center; related notes use a horizontal sequence. A stored phase does not move automatically when you follow a link.

## Use it

Start with a note you are developing, inspect its actual recorded neighbors, and decide which stage each belongs to. Use Assign category only after reviewing its native property preview. Workflow arrows and captions explain the category sequence; they neither create links nor prove that one idea caused another. You can reverse the layout, choose another focus anchor or edit aliases without changing graph evidence.

## Limits

Only the bounded direct neighborhood is shown. Unassigned, Conflicting, Checking and Cannot classify remain distinct in Diagnostics. A rule/tag/type source can be configured instead, but it does not inherit property-write authority. If you change the source or values, update this Help to describe your own convention.
